verdict.rationale: A government business-filing portal could plausibly offer a natural-language or assistant interface, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only conventional SOSPortal web filing, search, ordering, and drafts, with no natural-language command capability. The filing host's robots.txt also bans AI agents by name, which points away from agent-driven operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
